title: Unit 26 Consolidation: Central America
goal: Review the unit on Central America: Nicaragua, El Salvador, Guatemala, the Cold War and the peace accords.
grammar: consolidation of revolution, conflict, intervention and peace

items: I can use the pluperfect to say what had already happened in Nicaragua before 1979.
I can use cuando and mientras to link the events of the Salvadoran war.
I can use que and quien to add information about the Guatemalan commission and its findings.
I can use sin embargo and no obstante to contrast what the United States did and what was said against it.
I can put the events of the peace process in order.
